Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring development and use of the grants, contracts, and loan management system by state agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the grants, contracts, and loan managementsystem; and adding a new section to chapter 43.41 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.41 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The office shall develop and maintain a grants, contracts, andloan management system for use by all state agencies. State agenciesmust use the grants, contracts, and loan management system developed bythe office. Beginning July 1, 2008, the department of ecology and thedepartment of community, trade, and economic development must use thesystem. By July 1, 2012, all other state agencies shall use thesystem. (2) The legislative evaluation and accountability program shallhave access to the grants, contracts, and loan management system put inplace by the office. (3) As part of the grants, contracts, and loan management system,the office must develop a single searchable web site accessible by thepublic, at no cost to access information, on awards of state grants,contracts, and loans. p. 1 HB 2931 (a) At a minimum, the searchable web site shall contain a link tothe public disclosure commission's searchable campaign finance databaseand shall include the following information on awards: (i) The name of the entity receiving the award, as well as thenames of any parent company or affiliations; (ii) The amount of the award; (iii) The amount paid by fiscal year; (iv) Information on the award, including purpose of the award,funding agency, program, and division; and award title descriptive ofthe purpose of each funding action; (v) The location of the entity receiving the award and the primarylocation of performance under the award, including the city and county;and (vi) Any other relevant information specified by the office. (b) Beginning July 1, 2008, awards of grants, contracts, and loans made by the department of ecology and the department of community,trade, and economic development must be posted on the web site. ByJuly 1, 2010, awards of grants, contracts, and loans made by all stateagencies shall be posted on the web site. (c) The director is authorized to designate one or more stateagencies to participate in the development, establishment, operation,and support of the web site. (d) The web site shall include a comment section that will allowthe public to provide input about the utility of the web site andrecommendations for improvements. (e) Information shall be displayed on the web site immediatelyafter an award is made. Any changes to the original award must belisted on the web site. (4) For purposes of this section: (a) "Award" means state financial assistance and expendituresincluding grants, subgrants, loans, awards, cooperative agreements,contracts, subcontracts, purchase orders, task orders, and deliveryorders. (b) "Entity" means any corporation, association, partnership,limited liability company, limited liability partnership, soleproprietorship, legal business, or person in receipt of a grant,contract, loan, award, or any other financial award or assistance froman agency of the state. HB 2931 p. 2 (c) "Searchable web site" means a web site that allows the publicto search and aggregate state funding of grants, contracts, and loansin order to determine the total amount of state funding awarded andpaid to an entity through a state award by fiscal year, and downloaddata from searches.
